concepts.title: DNA Content Dynamics in Cell Cycle
concepts.definition: In brief, the cell cycle entails specific phases where the quantity of genetic material doubles during synthesis and returns to the original level after division.
concepts.key_idea: DNA content doubles in S-phase and halves during M-phase.
question_patterns: calculate the DNA content at G2 phase
what is the DNA amount after S phase
find the final DNA content after mitosis
how much DNA remains after M phase

solution_steps.explain: Mitosis divides the cell into two, halving the DNA per nucleus

concepts.title: Mitosis Characteristics
concepts.definition: In brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, a process of nuclear division where the parent cell produces two daughter cells with matching genetic information.
question_patterns: verify the chromosome count in daughter cells
compare parent and daughter chromosome number
what is the result of mitotic division

solution_steps.explain: Mitosis ensures the progeny cells have the same chromosome count as the parent cell.

concepts.title: Meiosis Reduction
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, a specialized cell division that reduces the chromosome number by half to produce haploid gametes.
concepts.key_idea: Reduction division produces four haploid cells from one diploid cell.
question_patterns: calculate the chromosome number after meiosis
how many chromosomes are in gametes
what is the result of meiotic division
find the ploidy of daughter cells

solution_steps.explain: Meiosis reduces the chromosome count to half for sexual reproduction

worked_examples.question_pattern: If a cell has {initial_dna} DNA content at G1, what is the content after S phase?
